class.name: FmodPluginsSettings
class.brief_description: Configuration resource for loading FMOD plugins.
class.description:
FmodPluginsSettings defines which FMOD DSP plugins should be loaded at startup. Configure it in the FMOD section of Project Settings under the Plugins category by pointing to a saved resource file.
Both dynamic (shared library) plugins and statically linked plugins can be configured here.

method.name: get_dynamic_plugin_list
method.description: Returns the list of dynamic plugin filenames to load.

method.name: get_fmod_plugins_base_path
method.description: Returns the base directory path where plugin files are located.

method.name: get_static_plugins_methods
method.description: Returns the array of [FmodStaticPluginMethod] resources describing statically linked plugins.

method.name: set_dynamic_plugin_list
method.description: Sets the list of dynamic plugin filenames (without path — relative to [member plugins_base_path]).

method.name: set_plugins_base_path
method.description: Sets the base directory for dynamic plugin files.

method.name: set_static_plugins_methods
method.description: Sets the array of [FmodStaticPluginMethod] resources for statically linked plugins.

members.member: Filenames of dynamic (shared library) FMOD plugins to load at startup. Files are looked up relative to [member plugins_base_path].
Directory containing FMOD plugin shared libraries.
An array of [FmodStaticPluginMethod] resources that describe statically linked FMOD plugins.
